sources.title: Systematic annotation of a complete adult male Drosophila nerve cord connectome reveals principles of functional organisation
evidence: SNpp41 is predicted to inhibit tibia flexor and accessory tibia flexor motor neurons via GABAergic IN19A015 while activating tibia extensor.
SNpp39 is predicted to inhibit tibia extensor via GABAergic IN19A005; IN19A005 also inhibits IN19A015, disinhibiting tibia flexor and accessory tibia flexor.
The authors describe the two hook types as exerting opposing effects on tibia extensor versus flexor muscles, consistent with directional tibia responses.

sources.title: Functional architecture of neural circuits for leg proprioception in Drosophila
evidence: 8Aa responds to hook flexion and 13Bb responds to hook extension.
13Bb receives direct synaptic input from hook-extension axons and responds during tibia extension.
The paper frames these pathways in resistance-reflex control; it notes that 13Ba encodes tibia extension and drives tibia flexion when activated.

sources.title: Central processing of leg proprioception in Drosophila
evidence: 13Ba neurons encode extension of the femur-tibia joint.
Optogenetic activation of 13Ba drives femur-tibia flexion, providing an experimentally observed extension-signal-to-opposing-flexion motor relationship.

sources.title: Virtual Fly Brain MaleCNS SNpp39 examples
evidence: MaleCNS systematic type SNpp39 is classified as a femoral chordotonal hook neuron.

sources.title: Virtual Fly Brain MaleCNS SNpp41 examples
evidence: MaleCNS systematic type SNpp41 is classified as a femoral chordotonal hook neuron.

SNpp39: Its reconstructed premotor sign inhibits tibia extensor and disinhibits tibia flexors.
That opposing motor effect is consistent with a resistance-reflex response to sensed tibia extension.
SNpp41: Its reconstructed premotor sign inhibits tibia flexors and activates tibia extensor.
That opposing motor effect is consistent with a resistance-reflex response to sensed tibia flexion.

circuit_consistency_inference.note: The 13B/14A downstream-lineage comparison is not used as a direct type-to-polarity mapping because the cited sources do not explicitly equate a MANC systematic hook type with Chen's flexion/extension driver identity.

governance.next_unlock_condition: A direct type-to-polarity annotation/match, or an independently auditable cross-dataset mapping that explicitly binds SNpp39/SNpp41 to hook extension/flexion identities.
